## 0) Business context
GreenHalo is an **emissions management / carbon accounting + sustainability reporting SaaS** (positioned as “Calculate Carbon Footprint” and “Sustainability Reporting Software”), likely targeting **mid-market to enterprise** (explicit savings claims for medium/large orgs). Primary conversion goal appears to be **demo/trial → signup** (nav includes “Interactive Demo” and “Get Started” links to app signup).

---

## 1) Funnel map
Pages captured and purpose + primary CTA:

1) **Homepage** — https://www.greenhalo.nz/  
   **Purpose:** Explain product value + drive evaluation.  
   **Primary CTAs observed:** “Get Started” (links to `app.greenhalo.nz/auth/signup`), “Interactive Demo” (links to `app.greenhalo.nz/auth/demo`).

2) **Pricing page** — https://www.greenhalo.nz/pricing  
   **Purpose:** Plan selection + push to signup.  
   **Primary CTA observed:** “Get Started” (links to `app.greenhalo.nz/auth/signup?subscriptionTier=2` and `...Tier=3`).

3) **(Text context only) About** — https://www.greenhalo.nz/about  
   **Purpose:** Brand story.  
   **Primary CTAs observed:** “Interactive Demo” (links to app demo).  
   **Above-the-fold not observed in provided content.**

4) **(Text context only) Resource Hub** — https://www.greenhalo.nz/resourcehub  
   **Purpose:** Content marketing / education.  
   **Primary CTA observed:** “Interactive Demo” (links to app demo).  
   **Above-the-fold not observed in provided content.**

---

## 2) Executive summary
- **Biggest conversion blocker:** The primary conversion paths are split between **“Interactive Demo” and “Get Started”** without clear guidance on which is best for which buyer (and there’s also a “30 Day Free Trial” email CTA). This creates decision friction at the moment of action.  
  **Evidence:** Homepage header shows “Interactive Demo” + “Login” and hero CTAs show “Get Started” + “Interactive Demo”; homepage text context includes `mailto:...subject=30 Day Free Trial with GreenHalo`.

- **Biggest trust/credibility gap:** **No customer logos, reviews, or case studies detected** in text context; only an awards-style image appears. For a data-heavy ESG/carbon platform, missing trust proof (security/compliance/integrations) will likely suppress demo/trial starts.  
  **Evidence:** SOCIAL PROOF: “None detected” on homepage/pricing/about/resourcehub; TRUST SIGNALS include an image alt: “nz project management conference & awards1.png”.

- **Biggest messaging/positioning gap:** Above the fold, value prop is directionally clear (“Take the guesswork out of calculating your carbon footprint”), but **differentiation vs other carbon accounting tools is not explicit** in the first impression (e.g., what’s uniquely automated, what standards, what exports besides Toitū).  
  **Evidence:** Homepage hero headline: “Take the guesswork out of calculating your carbon footprint.” Subhead references “automatic draw…”, but no concrete differentiator statement is visible above the fold beyond that.

- **Biggest friction point:** **Mobile performance is at the “Poor” threshold for LCP** (4.07s), which is a concrete conversion risk (slower first meaningful view → higher bounce, fewer CTA clicks).  
  **Evidence (PageSpeed):** Mobile LCP **4.07s** (Poor >4s), Mobile FCP **3.16s** (Poor >3s).

- **Highest-impact quick win:** **Unify to one primary CTA** per page (and consistent labeling across homepage + pricing) with microcopy like “No credit card required” (if true—otherwise don’t claim). At minimum, add **clarifying decision copy** (“Start with the interactive demo” vs “Create your account”).  
  **Evidence:** Homepage shows two hero CTAs (“Get Started” + “Interactive Demo”). Pricing shows “Get Started.”

- **CTA consistency verdict:** **Inconsistent.** Homepage promotes “Get Started” + “Interactive Demo,” while elsewhere “30 Day Free Trial” appears only via a **mailto** “Contact Us” CTA in text context; pricing is strictly “Get Started.”  
  **Evidence:** Homepage CTAs list includes `Contact Us -> mailto:...subject=30 Day Free Trial...`; pricing page CTAs list includes “Get Started” tier links; header includes “Interactive Demo”.

---

## 3) Conversion scorecard (weighted)

| Dimension | Score /10 | Weight | Weighted |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Value prop & differentiation | 6 | 2× | 12 |
| Trial / demo CTA clarity | 5 | 2× | 10 |
| Pricing plan clarity | 6 | 1.5× | 9 |
| Trust & social proof (logos, case studies, reviews) | 2 | 1.5× | 3 |
| Signup / onboarding friction | 4 | 1× | 4 |
| Feature communication | 6 | 1× | 6 |
| Mobile experience | 4 | 1× | 4 |

Overall score = sum(weighted) / 10 = **4.8 / 10**

Rationales (one line each):
- **Value prop & differentiation (6/10):** Clear problem (“calculating your carbon footprint”), but limited above-fold unique proof.  
- **Trial/demo CTA clarity (5/10):** Multiple action paths (“Get Started”, “Interactive Demo”, “Contact Us” trial email) with no routing logic.  
- **Pricing clarity (6/10):** Prices and feature bullets are visible, but plan comparison logic and inclusions (sites, storage) are dense.  
- **Trust & social proof (2/10):** “None detected” social proof; minimal trust evidence beyond an awards image.  
- **Signup friction (4/10):** “Get Started” sends to app signup, but signup steps/requirements are **Not observed in provided content.**  
- **Feature communication (6/10):** Many features listed; needs stronger prioritization and buyer-based outcomes.  
- **Mobile experience (4/10):** Mobile LCP is Poor (4.07s) and FCP is Poor (3.16s), risking drop-offs before CTA view/interaction.

---

## 4) Above-the-fold analysis

### A) Homepage (desktop-above-fold) — https://www.greenhalo.nz/
**What’s visible above the fold (from screenshot):**
- Top nav with “About, Contact, FAQs, Resource Hub, Pricing,” plus a prominent **“Interactive Demo”** button and “Login”.
- Hero headline: **“Take the guesswork out of calculating your carbon footprint.”**
- Two hero CTAs: **“Get Started”** and **“Interactive Demo”**
- A hero illustration (trees).

**Clarity & gaps:**
- Value prop is clear at a high level, but **what makes GreenHalo different** is not explicit above fold (beyond “guesswork out”).  
- Two CTAs are visible but **no guidance** which to choose (trial vs demo vs talk to sales).  
- Trust signals above fold: **Not observed in provided content** (logos/reviews/security badges not visible above fold).

### B) Pricing page (desktop) — https://www.greenhalo.nz/pricing
**What’s visible above the fold (from screenshot):**
- Headline: **“Choose Your Plan”** with descriptive paragraph.
- Two pricing cards visible:  
  - “Small Business $149 + GST / month”  
  - “Pro $999 + GST / month”
- Each plan has feature bullets and a **“Get Started”** button.

**Clarity & gaps:**
- Pricing is visible immediately (good), but the **comparison is mostly long bullet lists**; key differences aren’t visually prioritized.  
- No trust reassurance near purchase decision above fold (e.g., onboarding help, support, data security): **Not observed in provided content** above fold.

### C) Homepage (mobile viewport 390px) — https://www.greenhalo.nz/
**What’s visible above the fold (from screenshot):**
- Hamburger menu, logo.
- Same hero headline.
- The hero CTAs appear lower; above-fold shows a cookie banner overlay (“Accept”) and “We’re an ESG Award Finalist!” block appears early in the scroll.

**Clarity & gaps:**
- Cookie banner may compete with CTA visibility on small screens.  
  **Evidence:** Mobile screenshot shows cookie prompt overlay with “Accept”.
- Mobile speed risk (LCP 4.07s) may delay hero content/CTAs.

### D) Pricing page (mobile) — https://www.greenhalo.nz/pricing
**What’s visible above the fold (from screenshot):**
- “Choose Your Plan” headline and paragraph.
- “Pro $999 + GST / month” plan begins with bullets; “Small Business” is below.

**Clarity & gaps:**
- On mobile, users see one plan at a time; it’s harder to compare quickly.  
- Potential risk of “which plan is right?” because “Pro” appears first without a selector or comparison summary above fold (as seen).

## 5) Top 7 issues (ranked by Impact × Confidence)

### 1) Confusing conversion path: demo vs signup vs “30 Day Free Trial” contact email are not unified
- **Impact:** High  
- **Effort:** S  
- **Confidence:** High  
- **Evidence:**  
  - Homepage hero shows **two CTAs**: “Get Started” and “Interactive Demo” (hero area).  
  - Text context CTAs include `Contact Us -> mailto:info@greenhalo.nz?subject=30 Day Free Trial with GreenHalo`.  
  - Pricing page uses **“Get Started”** only (pricing cards).
- **Recommendation:** Choose a primary path per ICP:  
  - For mid-market/enterprise: make **“Book a demo”** (or “Interactive Demo”) primary, with “Start trial” secondary.  
  - For self-serve SMB: make **“Start free trial”** primary, with “View interactive demo” secondary.  
  Add one line under CTAs explaining the difference (e.g., “Interactive demo: no setup. Start trial: connect your data.”).
- **Test idea:** Hypothesis → A clarified primary CTA + decision microcopy increases demo/trial starts.  
  - **Primary metric:** Demo starts (clicks to `/auth/demo`) + signup starts (clicks to `/auth/signup`)  
  - **Guardrail:** Contact form submissions (don’t cannibalize if valuable)  
  - **MDE:** +10–15% increase in combined demo+signup starts

---

### 2) Weak social proof for a high-trust, data-heavy SaaS category
- **Impact:** High  
- **Effort:** M  
- **Confidence:** High  
- **Evidence:** SOCIAL PROOF shows “None detected” on homepage and pricing page; no customer logos/reviews visible in screenshots. One trust image appears: “We’re an ESG Award Finalist!” (homepage section below hero).
- **Recommendation:** Add a proof block near the hero and again on pricing:  
  - Customer logos row (if available), 1–2 quantified outcomes (e.g., time saved, audit readiness), and 1 testimonial with name/company (if permissible).  
  - If you can’t use logos, add “Used by sustainability teams at…” with sectors, or anonymized proof.
- **Test idea:**  
  - **Hypothesis:** Adding recognizable proof near CTA increases CTA clicks.  
  - **Primary metric:** Hero CTA CTR to demo/signup  
  - **Guardrail:** Bounce rate  
  - **MDE:** +8–12% CTR lift

---

### 3) Mobile Core Web Vital: LCP is “Poor” (4.07s), likely increasing bounce before CTAs engage
- **Impact:** High  
- **Effort:** M/L  
- **Confidence:** High  
- **Evidence (PageSpeed):** Mobile LCP **4.07s** (Poor >4s), FCP **3.16s** (Poor >3s).
- **Recommendation:** Prioritize largest above-fold assets:  
  - Compress/optimize hero imagery (trees illustration), ensure critical CSS, defer non-critical scripts.  
  - Confirm the LCP element (likely hero area) and optimize it first.
- **Test idea:**  
  - **Hypothesis:** Improving mobile LCP below 3.0s increases demo/signup starts.  
  - **Primary metric:** Mobile CTA CTR + demo/signup starts per session  
  - **Guardrail:** Mobile bounce rate  
  - **MDE:** +5–10% improvement in mobile conversion rate

---

### 4) Pricing page lacks “decision support” (who each plan is for) above the fold
- **Impact:** Med/High  
- **Effort:** S/M  
- **Confidence:** High  
- **Evidence:** Pricing shows “Small Business” and “Pro” with long bullet lists; no visible “Best for…” labels or usage-based guidance in the above-fold pricing cards (desktop screenshot).
- **Recommendation:** Add 1-line qualifiers under plan names:  
  - “Small Business — best for 1 site / light automation” (align to actual inclusions shown: “One location/site included”).  
  - “Pro — best for multi-site reporting + data insights” (align to bullets).  
  Also add a short “Need more than X sites? Contact us” link near buttons (you already mention more sites in bullets).
- **Test idea:**  
  - **Hypothesis:** Adding plan fit labels increases “Get Started” clicks.  
  - **Primary metric:** Pricing → signup CTR  
  - **Guardrail:** Pricing page exit rate  
  - **MDE:** +10% CTR lift

---

### 5) Feature differentiation is buried in dense bullet lists (hard to scan, especially on mobile)
- **Impact:** Med  
- **Effort:** M  
- **Confidence:** High  
- **Evidence:** Pricing plans contain many bullets (e.g., “Automated data feeds…”, “Audit document storage…”, “Live carbon price…”) and mobile view shows a long list before the next plan appears.
- **Recommendation:** Convert bullets into 5–7 “headline features” with icons + expandable “All features” section. Prioritize differentiators like “Automated Toitū Envirocare export” and “Automated data feeds” into a “Why GreenHalo” comparison row.
- **Test idea:**  
  - **Hypothesis:** Scannable plan cards improve engagement and clicks.  
  - **Primary metric:** Scroll depth to CTAs + “Get Started” clicks  
  - **Guardrail:** Time on page (don’t inflate without clicks)  
  - **MDE:** +8% “Get Started” clicks

---

### 6) Contact form CTA label “Send” is non-specific and appears as a primary action in multiple pages
- **Impact:** Med  
- **Effort:** S  
- **Confidence:** High  
- **Evidence:** CTAs list includes `BUTTON: Send` on homepage and pricing; screenshots show a “Get in Touch” form with a **Send** button (footer section).
- **Recommendation:** Change button to intent-based labels:  
  - “Request a demo” / “Ask a question” / “Talk to sales” (choose one consistent with page intent).  
  Add expectation microcopy (e.g., “We’ll reply within 1 business day.”) if true (otherwise don’t claim).
- **Test idea:**  
  - **Hypothesis:** Specific form CTA increases form completion rate.  
  - **Primary metric:** Form submissions / form views  
  - **Guardrail:** Spam rate / low-quality leads (if tracked)  
  - **MDE:** +10% form submissions

---

### 7) Missing security/privacy reassurance near conversion moments (demo/signup/pricing)
- **Impact:** Med  
- **Effort:** S/M  
- **Confidence:** Med  
- **Evidence:** Trust signals listed only as phone number and an awards image; no security/compliance statements are shown in provided text/screenshots.  
  **Security badges/claims:** Not observed in provided content.
- **Recommendation:** Add a lightweight trust row near primary CTAs: “Data security”, “Privacy”, “Audit-ready reporting” with links to relevant pages (if they exist). If you have Toitū export prominently, add a short line clarifying what that means for auditors (without overclaiming).
- **Test idea:**  
  - **Hypothesis:** Trust microcopy near CTAs reduces hesitation and increases clicks.  
  - **Primary metric:** CTA CTR to demo/signup  
  - **Guardrail:** Bounce rate  
  - **MDE:** +5–8% CTR lift

---

## 6) Mobile considerations
1) **Poor mobile LCP (4.07s)** likely delays first meaningful content/CTAs on 4G, increasing bounce.  
   **Evidence:** PageSpeed mobile LCP 4.07s; FCP 3.16s.

2) **Plan comparison difficulty on mobile** (one long plan card at a time).  
   **Evidence:** Mobile pricing screenshot shows “Pro” plan bullets filling screen; “Small Business” appears later.

3) **Cookie banner competes with hero visibility** on small screens.  
   **Evidence:** Mobile homepage screenshot shows cookie prompt overlay with “Accept”.

4) **Tap target clarity for primary action**: On mobile homepage above fold, primary CTAs are not clearly visible in the very first view due to content stacking/overlays (based on screenshot).  
   **Evidence:** Mobile homepage shows headline + overlay; CTAs appear lower in the page.

5) **Floating chat/help button overlaps content risk** (present on pricing desktop screenshot as a floating icon).  
   **Evidence:** Desktop pricing screenshot shows a floating circular icon on the right side; on mobile this can obscure CTAs if not managed. (Mobile overlap **not observed**.)

---

## 7) Copy & CTA improvements (write the actual copy)

### 3 headline/value prop options
1) **“Automate carbon accounting and sustainability reporting—without the spreadsheet chaos.”**  
   Rationale: Mirrors the “spreadsheets” pain from About page story and positions automation.

2) **“Get audit-ready emissions data fast: measure, track, and report with automated data feeds.”**  
   Rationale: Pulls from homepage/meta (“Automatically draw your emissions data… measure, track, and report”).

3) **“Carbon footprint tracking for NZ organisations—built to streamline data collection and reporting.”**  
   Rationale: Matches the NZ focus (“designed for New Zealand organisations”) and emphasizes workflow outcome.

### 3 primary CTA label options
- **“Start your free trial”** (use only if trial is truly self-serve; trial details are not fully confirmed in provided content)  
- **“Try the interactive demo”**  
- **“Create your account”**

### 3 trust microcopy examples (place near CTA / form)
- **“See how GreenHalo pulls data automatically (where available).”** (aligns to pricing feature text)  
- **“Includes tailored onboarding options (3 hours free onboarding on Pro).”** (aligns to pricing text: “Three hours free on-boarding”)  
- **“Questions before you start? Contact our team.”** (aligns to phone number + contact form presence)

---

## 8) Experiment plan (2 weeks)

### Week 1 — 2 quick wins (low effort, high confidence)

**Test 1: CTA routing + labels (Homepage hero)**
- **Hypothesis:** If we clarify the primary action (choose one: demo or get started) and add a one-line “which to choose,” more visitors will start a demo/signup.  
- **Primary metric:** Combined clicks to `/auth/demo` + `/auth/signup` (per session)  
- **Guardrail metric:** Bounce rate  
- **MDE:** 10%

**Test 2: Contact form CTA label + expectation microcopy**
- **Hypothesis:** Replacing “Send” with intent-specific copy (e.g., “Request a demo”) increases form submissions.  
- **Primary metric:** Form submit rate  
- **Guardrail metric:** Form abandonment rate (or time to complete)  
- **MDE:** 10–15%

### Week 2 — 2 bigger tests

**Test 3: Pricing page “Best for” + key differences module**
- **Hypothesis:** Adding “Best for” labels + a short comparison (sites included, storage, onboarding, key differentiators) increases “Get Started” CTR.  
- **Primary metric:** Pricing → signup click-through rate  
- **Guardrail metric:** Pricing page exits  
- **MDE:** 10%

**Test 4: Add social proof block near hero and on pricing**
- **Hypothesis:** Adding credible proof (logos/testimonial/quantified outcome) reduces perceived risk and increases demo/signup starts.  
- **Primary metric:** Demo/signup starts  
- **Guardrail metric:** Bounce rate  
- **MDE:** 8–12%

--- 

If you can share screenshots of the **actual app signup flow** (`/auth/signup`) and demo (`/auth/demo`), I can audit the highest-leverage point (field friction, step count, SSO options, error handling, and whether pricing promises match the signup experience).
